expect.why: The issuer reports no line for this product after 2025Q3. The break is one quarter wide and the issuer's, not this dataset's. Lilly's fourth-quarter 2025 release narrows Selected Products to Mounjaro, Zepbound and Verzenio, and the 2025 Form 10-K states this product only as full-year U.S. and outside-U.S. columns with no worldwide total, so no worldwide 2025Q4 figure is published at all. The line returns in the first quarter of 2026, where Lilly prints U.S., outside-U.S. and Total by therapeutic area. The series cannot cross the missing quarter without inventing it: the only route would sum two regional columns into a full year Lilly never printed as a total, then subtract nine months from that.

The issuer reports no line for this product after 2024Q3. The Form 10-K for 2024 and every Form 10-Q and 10-K from 2025 on contain no mention of Trajenta or linagliptin (counted 0 occurrences in each of the FY2024 10-K, the 2025Q1-Q3 and 2026Q1-Q2 10-Qs, the FY2025 10-K and the Q4 2024 earnings release; the 2025-2026 earnings releases were not individually counted), so no 2024Q4 figure exists and the quarter cannot be derived.

aggregated_with_other_products: Novo Nordisk never prints Esperoct (turoctocog alfa pegol) as its own line. In every quarterly financial report read (31 reports, the Q4 2018 report through the Q2 2026 report, 6-K exhibits caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; the only table rows that name Esperoct are the footnotes 'Comprises ...'), Esperoct is one of the products inside a larger line: 'Haemophilia' / 'Rare blood disorders', whose footnote lists NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen (and Alhemo from 2024). Running text gives only a country count for Esperoct (e.g. launched in nine countries, FY2019 report) and, from FY2021, a haemophilia A products class total (which, by inference, is NovoEight plus Esperoct, not Esperoct alone); no Esperoct sales figure appears in any table or sentence. No quarterly series can be cited without interpolation or summation across products, so none is staged.

not_reported_separately: Pfizer never prints Velsipity (etrasimod) revenue on its own line in any earnings release, 10-Q or 10-K from approval (Oct 2023) through the second quarter of 2026. Its Specialty Care product table lists Vyndaqel family, Xeljanz, Cibinqo and other named lines and closes with 'All other Specialty Care'; the FY2023 10-K lists Velsipity among Inflammation & immunology products without revenue. Measured: 0 of 12 releases (2023Q3-2026Q2) carry a Velsipity row with figures. Inferred: Velsipity revenue sits in 'All other Specialty Care' (the filings do not say so).
